_doc: Adventure-map resource pickups, 40x40 like the imported Pulp Wars ore and treasure (pickup class 40-48 px, centred, calmer than units). Layers as Pulp Wars' resource class: style, camera, light, class-resource, subject; no faction layer (resources are neutral). Essence is violet (hue about 270): not the Lost World red-orange, not a ground colour and not the turquoise shallow water. Ore is cool slate blue-grey iron, so it does not clash with the faction accent like the imported copper ore. Recipes are never edited after generation: add a new id (new seed) instead.

recipes.subject: Subject: a small neat stack of five chunky cut logs lying on their sides in a little pyramid, three on the bottom and two on top, the cut ends facing the viewer: pale cream-tan cut ends with one darker ring, dull mid-brown bark, colour #8a5a2c with #5a3a1c shadows, not orange and not red; the log stack is wide and is the only thing in the image.
recipes.negative: axe, person, tree, leaves, fire, campfire, orange wood, red, rope

recipes.subject: Subject: a small chunky heap of four jagged angular chunks of raw iron ore with sharp flat faceted faces: cool slate blue-grey rock, colour #6f7f99 with #46536b shadows and pale #b9c6d8 lit faces, with a few small bright silver-white metal glints; the ore heap is wide and is the only thing in the image.
recipes.negative: copper, orange, rust, brown, gold, crystals, glowing aura, gems, mine cart, pickaxe, person, round balls, spheres

recipes.subject: Subject: a small heap of shiny gold coins with one small round sack of pale tawny cloth tied at the neck standing behind it, a few more coins spilling out of the sack; warm bright gold coins, colour #f2c230 with #b07a10 shadows and pale yellow glints; the coins and the sack are the only things in the image.

recipes.notes: gold-a's coins read as copper-orange at 1:1: a lemon-gold named in words and hex, a cream sack instead of tawny.

recipes.subject: Subject: a low wide heap of five chunky blocky lumps of raw iron ore, dark charcoal grey, colour #4b5262 with #2e3340 shadows, each lump crossed by thick bright silver-white metal veins, colour #dfe6ef; the ore heap is wide and low and is the only thing in the image.

recipes.notes: ore-a reads as a small spiky grey rock (close to a mountain); try a darker blocky heap with bright metal veins.

recipes.subject: Change only the coins: recolour every orange coin to bright lemon yellow gold, colour #ffd23f with #d99a12 shadows and white glints, not orange. Keep the brown sack, the outline and the art style exactly the same.
recipes.notes: Recolour edit of gold-a#0 (best shape; coins read as copper). gold-b drew a maroon sack.
